subtopic: Measure of an Arc and Central Angle
stem:
In figure 3.37, points G, D, E, F are concyclic points of a circle with centre C.

\(\angle ECF = 70^\circ\), \(m(\text{arc DGF}) = 200^\circ\) find \(m(\text{arc DE})\) and \(m(\text{arc DEF})\).

In fig 3.38 \(\triangle QRS\) is an equilateral triangle. Prove that,

(1) arc RS \(\cong\) arc QS \(\cong\) arc QR

(2) \(m(\text{arc QRS}) = 240^\circ\).
note: The book marks this question with a star (2*), its convention for a challenging question.
